 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0025
 Ryan Roberts, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
April 16, 2025
Plaintiff's counsel:
Carlos Fox, Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
PARTIES
Plaintiff Ryan Roberts is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision
described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to transact insurance business in the State of Texas,
which issued the policy of automobile coverage under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this claim is brought.
FACTS
On June 1, 2024, Plaintiff was lawfully stopped in traffic at an intersection in Katy, Texas, waiting for the signal to change. A
second vehicle, operated by a driver insured by Defendant, approached from behind at a speed too great for the conditions and
struck the rear of Plaintiff's vehicle with considerable force. The impact pushed Plaintiff's vehicle forward and jolted Plaintiff's
body violently against the seat and restraint system. Plaintiff reported the collision to Defendant promptly, provided a recorded
statement, and submitted the information Defendant requested to evaluate the claim.
NEGLIGENCE
The driver of the insured vehicle owed Plaintiff a duty to operate that vehicle with ordinary care, to maintain a safe following
distance, to keep a proper lookout, and to control speed in light of traffic conditions. That driver breached those duties by failing
to stop, by following too closely, and by failing to apply brakes in time to avoid the collision. Defendant is liable for the
negligence of its insured under the terms of the policy and applicable Texas law, and Defendant has failed to fairly and promptly
evaluate and pay the covered loss as required by the Texas Insurance Code.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff sustained neck and back strain, accompanied by pain, stiffness, limited range of
motion, headaches, and muscle spasms. Plaintiff sought medical evaluation and treatment, incurred reasonable and necessary
medical expenses, lost time from work, and continues to experience pain and reduced function in daily activities. Plaintiff seeks
recovery of economic and non-economic damages witihn the limits of the policy, together with statutory interest, court costs, and
attorney's fees as permitted by law, in an amount of $113,000.00.
